coverage.summary: Just cause protections apply to all rental units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance. These include most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with any tenancy start date, rooming houses, new construction (certificate of occupancy after June 1980), most condominiums, and government-subsidized units. Only the listed exempt types fall outside it: Golden Duplex, owner-shared kitchen/bath where the owner lived there at the start of the tenancy, post-Nov 7, 2018 tenancies on owner-occupied ADU properties, university housing, and nonprofit cooperatives.
coverage.owner_conditions: The shared kitchen/bath exemption applies only if the landlord lived on the property at the start of the tenancy. The Golden Duplex and ADU-property exemptions require owner occupancy.
